gepa_phase_partition: external replay requests matched against exact request cache; optimization is raw provider total minus matched replay
mars_phase_partition: per-iteration target usage plus run-local optimizer usage; external replay is raw run total minus summed optimization evaluations

record_identity_audit.Diversity_limit: raw ledger has no provider request ID, so upstream duplicate provider attempts are NOT_RECOVERABLE_ZERO_API
record_identity_audit.GEPA: provider request IDs persisted and unique
record_identity_audit.MARS_limit: cache filename identifies serialized request, while cache contents do not persist provider request IDs
